about_the_game:
Crimson Cruise is a thrilling hidden-object puzzle adventure set aboard a glamorous ocean liner with a deadly secret. Step into the shoes of Claire Malone—a fearless vampire huntress posing as a journalist—as she investigates a string of mysterious disappearances linked to the creatures of the night. But not all monsters hide in the shadows. The ship’s enigmatic owner, Ethan Cross, is a vampire himself—one fighting to stop a brewing rebellion that threatens to expose and destroy them all.

As a violent storm traps everyone at sea, and dark forces rise from the ship’s cursed cargo hold, Claire and Ethan must join forces. Can they trust each other long enough to survive the voyage—or will the "Fortune’s Dream" become their tomb?

🔹 Unlock a gripping bonus chapter and face the fallout of the vampire conspiracy.

🔹 Explore richly detailed locations. From elegant moonlit decks to hidden cargo bays and secret vampire chambers.

🔹 Uncover hidden artifacts and secret messages to piece together the ship’s dark history.

🔹 Solve challenging puzzles and mini-games to unlock achievements and hidden story threads.

Set sail... if you dare.
